name: Stock Ledger Summary
query:
SELECT 
    sle.item_code AS "Item:Link/Item:150",
    sle.warehouse AS "Warehouse:Link/Warehouse:150",
    SUM(sle.actual_qty) AS "Balance Quantity:Float:120"
FROM 
    `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle
WHERE 
    sle.docstatus = 1  -- Consider only submitted entries
GROUP BY 
    sle.item_code, sle.warehouse
ORDER BY 
    sle.item_code, sle.warehouse;
